method.routeGenerator: N total HTTP routes: N-2 fillers (i = 0..N-3, shape FILLER[i % 5] with k = floor(i / 5): GET /res{k}/items, POST /res{k}/items, GET /res{k}/items/:id, PUT /res{k}/items/:id(\d+), GET /res{k}/files/:path*), then GET /static/target/leaf, then GET /late/:group/:id declared last. All buffer transport.
method.workloadOrder: for each run: for each router (order alternates per run): for count in routeCounts: for workload in workloads
method.operation: resolveRoute(routes, method, path); on undefined, allowedMethods(routes, path)
